displayAddress: St. Oswalds Terrace, Guiseley, Leeds, West Yorkshire
description:
Situated within walking distance of Guiseley's Leisure Centre, high street and retail parks and steeped in character this property would make an ideal first time buyers home or investment property.

Entering the property to an inviting sitting room with high ceilings, ornate coving and ceiling rose and fireplace. Through to a generous dining kitchen with a range of units in a Shaker style and appliances consisting of electric oven, hood and gas hob and inset sink unit. Worcestor Bosch boiler. A large ornate dresser adds charm as well as additional storage. Stairs leading down to a converted basement which is so versatile.

To the first floor are two bedrooms. The first a good size master with views over the churchyard, and a second bedroom to the rear with a lovely roof top and chimney views. A smart family bathroom with tiled bath and shower over, low level WC and handbasin with built in storage.

To the front of the property is a pleasant enclosed courtyard providing seating areas with views over the church yard.
Side driveway giving access to the parking areas at the rear with space for outside seating.

If you are looking for a charming property close to all Guiseley has to offer then No.41 could be for you.

TWO BEDROOM BACK-TO-BACK MID TERRACE PROPERTY ARRANGED OVER FOUR FLOORS, OFFERING TWO DOUBLE BEDROOMS, A SPACIOUS LOUNGE, LOWER GROUND FLOOR KITCHEN, HOUSE BATHROOM AND ENCLOSED PAVED FRONT GARDEN. REQUIRING SOME MODERNISATION, THIS PROPERTY OFFERS EXCELLENT POTENTIAL.

PROPERTY OVERVIEW

DPSH The Estate Agent is pleased to present this two bedroom back-to-back mid terrace property, offering accommodation arranged over four floors and providing an excellent opportunity for buyers looking to put their own stamp on a home.

The property features a kitchen on the lower ground floor, a spacious lounge on the ground floor, a double bedroom and house bathroom on the first floor, and a further generously proportioned double bedroom occupying the second floor, complete with a large dormer window.

Although requiring some modernisation, the property offers considerable potential and could appeal to first-time buyers, investors or those looking for a renovation project.

LOWER GROUND FLOOR

The lower ground floor accommodates the kitchen, accessed externally via steps leading down from the enclosed front garden. This level offers the opportunity to create a modern and practical kitchen space, subject to the buyer's preferred layout and improvements.

GROUND FLOOR

The ground floor comprises a spacious lounge, providing a comfortable main reception room with a window to the front aspect allowing natural light into the space.

An entrance door provides access from the front garden, while an internal door leads to the staircase connecting the ground floor with the first floor accommodation.

The lounge offers ample potential to create an attractive living area following modernisation.

FIRST FLOOR

The first floor landing provides access to the principal bedroom, house bathroom and staircase leading to the second floor.

Bedroom one is a well-proportioned double bedroom featuring a window overlooking the front aspect, with space for a double bed and additional bedroom furniture.

The house bathroom is positioned off the landing and comprises a bath, wash hand basin and WC, with a window providing natural light.

SECOND FLOOR

The second floor is occupied by a spacious second double bedroom, offering a versatile room with plenty of potential.

A large dormer window to the front aspect provides natural light and additional headroom, creating a particularly appealing space that could be used as a bedroom, guest room or home office.

OUTSIDE

To the front of the property is a fully enclosed, paved garden, providing a low-maintenance outdoor space with potential for seating and relaxation.

Separate external staircases provide access to the lower ground floor kitchen and the ground floor entrance, creating a distinctive arrangement across the different levels of the property.

On-street parking is available nearby.

LOCATION

The property is situated within an established residential street, with access to local amenities and surrounding transport links. Its traditional back-to-back terrace design and accommodation arranged over four floors make it an interesting opportunity for buyers seeking a property with character and scope for improvement.

EXPLORE MORE

This property offers an excellent opportunity for buyers looking for a home they can modernise to their own taste or investors seeking a property with potential.

Further photographs will be added to the listing in due course. In the meantime, please refer to the floor plan for a better understanding of the accommodation and its layout. A virtual tour will also be made available when completed.

Contact DPSH The Estate Agent to arrange your viewing and discover the potential this property has to offer.
